text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find Manhattan Cafe on the roof, talking to a certain someone.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's because I'm racing too much? Maybe… I do feel kind of sluggish…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …That could be part of it too. I just… feel so worn out lately…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I get in bed, shut my eyes… and next thing I know, it's morning…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I just want to dream again…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: To dive into that sea of stars, and sink quietly… deeper and deeper…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She definitely looks tired. The nonstop racing must be taking its toll on her. I should adjust her schedule.
